metadata.case_name: CHAN CHEUK YIU v. CHAN HO KWAN

plaintiff.occupation_before: wielder; part time delivery worker for Pizza Hut
plaintiff.occupation_after: wielder at K. Wah Construction Company

source: He sustained head, right wrist and right knee injuries.

injuries.description: A fracture was discovered on the distal radius of his right wrist.
source: A fracture was discovered on the distal radius of his right wrist.
He was given close reduction and short arm plaster for his fractured radius.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: A 5cm laceration was found at the antero-lateral joints of his right knee to the level of the surface of the joint; marginal osteophyte present medially at his right knee joint, with slight compartment narrowing; reduced mobility of right knee.
source: A 5cm laceration was found at the antero-lateral joints of his right knee to the level of the surface of the joint.

The residuary effect the injuries had on the plaintiff was a mild limitation on the flexion and exertion of his right knee. A marginal osteophyte was present medially at his right knee joint, with slight compartment narrowing.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: Disfiguring scar on the lateral aspect of his right knee
Residual stiffness in his right wrist
Reduced degree of mobility of his right knee
Mild limitation on the flexion and exertion of his right knee
Marginal osteophyte present medially at his right knee joint, with slight compartment narrowing
Grinding pain on his patello-femoral joint
Reservation in climbing scaffold and stairs

treatments_received: close reduction and short arm plaster for his fractured radius
Debridement, irrigation and sutures were carried out on his knee

losses.description: The knee injuries resulted in reduced mobility in the plaintiff's right knee.
Disfiguring scar on the lateral aspect of his right knee.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He used to play football once or twice a week. After the accident he no longer played football.
